basic_info.description: First time on the market in decades! This bright, sun-filled OCEAN VIEW corner home is ideally located near public transit, including MUNI lines on Judah and buses on Sunset Blvd and Noriega. Shops, restaurants, schools, and parks are all nearby. A rare find with two-car side-by-side garage parking, two-car driveway parking, and ample street parking. The top floor features a spacious living room with fireplace, formal dining room, kitchen, full bath with separate tub and shower, and two generous rear bedrooms with ocean views. An interior staircase leads to a lower-level bedroom, wet bar, and full bath - possibly an original in-law setup - with a separate entrance and its own address on Lawton Street. Enjoy the low-maintenance, private yard - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Recent updates include fresh interior and exterior paint, newly refinished hardwood floors, and newly installed hardwood in the kitchen and wet bar area. A unique opportunity in a prime Outer Sunset location!
